Chapter 6305: Desolate Tower

Chapter 6305: Desolate Tower

Of course, Jiang Qingmei knew it was special due to its location.

“What kind of treasure is it?” She asked softly.

“You tell me.” Li Qiye said.

“Hmm…” She couldn’t answer due to the lack of clues.

“Go feel it.” He smiled.

She took a deep breath and raised her hand for a touch.

“Buzz.” Light waves pulsed outward upon contact and the tiny stones ebbed and flowed in accordance.

An image popped up in her mind, resembling a chaotic expanse. As it changed, so did the outline of the stones.

It turned into a divine sword, a heavenly saber, a cauldron…

Whatever image she had in her mind, the stone would change accordingly.

“I see…” After coming up with all types of treasures, she couldn’t get the stone to settle on a single one.

The moment her thought stopped or if she removed her hand, the stone would revert to its initial appearance.

“It shows that your dao heart is not strong enough to stabilize it or make it reveal its true appearance.” Li Qiye said.

“I see.” She frowned.

“Let her see your true appearance.” Li Qiye smiled and gently tapped on it, causing a ripple.

“Crack.” The tiny stones moved after being initiated by the pulsing ripple.

“Creak.” Finally, a hand-sized pagoda appeared before them.

It had an azure color that didn’t belong to the mortal world. It seemed to have flown out from the river of time.

The gaps between the tiny stones disappeared so the pagoda looked seamless and perfect. It looked like it had grown on a mountain in this shape and fell off after reaching maturity.

“Pop.” A strand of immortal power manifested into reality and spread across Desolate Frontier.

The first affected was Jiang Qingmei who was the closest. She couldn’t withstand the strand and was pushed backward, nearly falling to the ground. Her knees buckled from the pressure.

Emperors and primal ancestors throughout Desolate Frontier fell on their knees. As for the disciples, they naturally became paralyzed.

“An immortal power!” The upper echelon thought this was the return of their progenitor.

“What is going on?!” Everyone else became afraid after losing control of their body.

Normally, they believed they were stronger than everyone else due to their affiliation. Alas, this strand said otherwise.

“Desolate Tower, the progenitor’s weapon!” Qingmei blurted, not expecting the weapon to be here.

“The legend is true.” She murmured after seeing the supreme immortal treasure.

This was one of the few in Old World. Another was in the possession of Supreme Black Ancestor.

She tried to move it to no avail. Another attempt at full force failed. She had converted her sacred anima three times, putting her on the same level as primal ancestors.

“I’m too weak to move it.” She said.

“It’s meant to be here.” Li Qiye said.

“So not for future descendants?” She became surprised.

“Do they deserve it? If they are capable enough to take it, so be it. If they are incapable, they are not qualified to wield it. Furthermore, parading it will only lead to sect destruction.” Li Qiye said.

“That is true.” She nodded.

“There is another reason why it is here.” Li Qiye said.

“Please elaborate.” She asked. Normally, such an artifact was meant to take down the enemy or suppress the battlefield.
